proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Generous initial free credits (~$10-15) upon signing up via GitHub; FLUX.1-schnell costs only $0.003 per image, meaning thousands of free generations.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides lightning-fast, highly reliable API endpoints for state-of-the-art models like FLUX.1 (schnell/dev) and SDXL. It is significantly faster than Together AI and has robust GitHub Actions compatibility without IP blocking.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Replace the broken Pollinations/Gemini image generation step in 'produce_coloring_book' and 'produce_kdp_cover' pipelines via curl/Python requests.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires a credit card or GitHub login to activate free credits; eventually becomes pay-as-you-go, though extremely cheap.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to register and list assets. No listing fees. Standard 88/12 revenue split.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Epic Games' unified marketplace (merging Unreal Engine Marketplace, Sketchfab, and Quixel). It represents a massive, highly active audience of gamedevs looking for 3D models, 2D textures, UI kits, and audio packs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Target distribution channel for 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' pipeline to publish 2D textures, UI assets, and low-poly models.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Strict curation standards for technical quality; asset metadata must be clean.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 2,500 free search queries upon signup. No credit card required.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides super fast, structured JSON data of Google Search, Google Images, Google Shopping, and Autocomplete. This completely bypasses Google's strict anti-scraping blocks on GitHub Actions runners.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrate into 'agent_opportunity_hunter' and 'agent_trendhunter' to fetch real-time search volumes and high-demand keywords without getting rate-limited.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Once the 2,500 free queries are exhausted, requires manual registration of a new account or a cheap paid plan ($1 per 1,000 queries).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Generous daily free tokens to run community or custom-built 'glifs' (workflows) via API.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Allows chaining of multiple AI steps (e.g., LLM prompt expansion -> FLUX image generation -> image vectorization/upscaling) into a single API call.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Can be used in 'produce_coloring_book' to run a specialized 'comic-to-vector' or 'coloring-lineart' Glif, delivering perfect black-and-white lines directly.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: API parameters can be complex to map initially; workflows built by others can occasionally go offline or change.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 2 free databases, 500MB database space, 5GB file storage, 50,000 monthly active users.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides a hosted PostgreSQL database with an instant REST API. Perfect for maintaining state, tracking generated assets, and logging sales from GitHub Actions without polluting git history with constant commits.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Use as the central state repository for 'agent_brain_meta' to dynamically read/write project status, avoiding git merge conflicts between runners.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Free projects are paused after 1 week of inactivity (easily kept alive with a scheduled GitHub Action ping).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to open a shop and list products. No listing fees.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: One of the largest subscription-based marketplaces for crafters, KDP publishers, and teachers. Sellers are paid per download from the subscription pool, generating passive income much faster than traditional marketplaces.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Perfect secondary marketplace for SVG packs from 'produce_svg_pack' and book interiors from 'produce_coloring_book' or 'produce_lowcontent_kdp'.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires passing a simple designer application portfolio check (can use generated high-quality mockups to pass).
